title: Rutter’s Selects NCR Voyix to Modernize Point-of-Sale Across its Retail Network
summary: Expanded long-term partnership includes adoption of the Voyix Commerce Platform, commercial fuel payments and managed services to unify retail, fuel and foodservice operations
body_markdown:
*Expanded long-term partnership includes adoption of the Voyix Commerce Platform, commercial fuel payments and managed services to unify retail, fuel and foodservice operations*


**ATLANTA — October 01, 2026 —** NCR Voyix (NYSE: VYX), a platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining, today announced a new multi-year enterprise agreement with Rutter’s, the oldest vertically integrated food company in the United States with nearly 100 convenience locations across the mid-Atlantic.


Under the agreement, Rutter’s is leveraging NCR Voyix’s extensive experience and capabilities across retail, restaurant and fuel to deploy a full suite of Voyix Commerce Platform applications to connect store, foodservice, and forecourt workflows on a unified platform. In addition to installing[Voyix POS for CFR](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/industry/retail/convenience-fuel) ,[Voyix Kitchen](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/platform/restaurant-applications/ordering-fulfillment) and Voyix Connect, Rutter’s will also adopt NCR Voyix’s managed and field support services. With Voyix POS for CFR, Rutter’s will be able to accept all major commercial fleet payment methods, including Corpay, WEX and Voyager fleet cards, further streamlining operations across its entire store footprint.


Rutter’s is the proud five-time recipient of the CSP Mystery Shop award for Best Customer Experience, having secured the title most recently in 2026. Additionally, Rutter’s is a four-time winner of the Convenience Store News Food Innovator of the Year and 2025 winner for Best Foodvenience in the World from Global Convenience. The expanded agreement supports Rutter's ongoing commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences, while establishing an integrated technology foundation to accelerate innovation and support future growth.


"At Rutter’s, innovation has always been at the core of how we serve our customers and operate our business," said **Scott Hartman, President and CEO, Rutter’s** . "As consumer expectations continue to evolve, we are investing in technology to create a more seamless and personalized experience across customer touchpoints. NCR Voyix has been a trusted partner for more than twenty years, and we are excited to build on this relationship as we continue to elevate the customer experience."


"We are very proud to expand our relationship with Rutter’s, an operator that has consistently set the standard for customer experience and operational excellence for more than a century," said **James G. Kelly, President and CEO, NCR Voyix** . "Our Voyix Commerce Platform applications will enhance Rutter’s ability to unify operations across retail, fuel and foodservice and support continued innovation, ultimately creating exceptional experiences for consumers and enhancing business outcomes.”


Inclusive of the Rutter’s agreement, NCR Voyix has now signed contracts with 27 customers for its Voyix Commerce Platform applications.


**NCR Voyix Participation at the NACS Show**
NCR Voyix will participate in the NACS Show in Las Vegas from October 7-9, 2026. At booth #C6522, attendees can experience live, immersive demonstrations showing how one modern commerce platform brings together retail and commercial fuel, food service, loyalty, payments and store operations across the forecourt, in-store and above-the-store experience. The demonstrations will show how convenience and fuel retailers can simplify operations, accelerate innovation and create seamless experiences that keep customers coming back.

**About NCR Voyix**
NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide. For more information, visit[NCR Voyix Official Website](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/) .


About Rutter’s
Rutter’s, a privately held chain of convenience stores headquartered in York, Pennsylvania, operates 94 locations in Pennsylvania, Maryland, Virginia, and West Virginia. Part of a family managed group of companies, the Rutter’s Companies include: a chain of convenience stores, a dairy and beverage company, and a real estate company. With roots dating back to 1747, Rutter’s 279-year history makes it the oldest vertically integrated food company in the United States. For more information, visit[official Rutter's Website](https://www.rutters.com/) .
